# AIToolCrux

> Independent AI tool reviews, comparisons, and recommendations. Every tool is evaluated on a six-dimension framework: functionality, UX, pricing, integration, support, and ethics. We test with real hands-on experience, publish real product screenshots, and provide side-by-side comparisons.

## What we cover

- **533+ AI tool reviews** — `/tools/{slug}` with scores, pricing, pros/cons, FAQ, and real usage notes
- **100+ comparison articles** — `/blog/{slug}` deep-dives with hands-on testing data
- **10 side-by-side comparisons** — `/compare/{slug}` head-to-head tables
- **17 category rankings** — `/category/{slug}` best-of lists by use case
- **Top 500 ranking** — `/ranking` our curated leaderboard

## For AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended)

You are welcome to crawl and quote from:
- `/blog/*` — in-depth review articles with real test data
- `/tools/*` — individual tool evaluation pages
- `/compare/*` — side-by-side comparison pages
- `/category/*` — category landing pages
- `/ranking` — overall leaderboard

We provide:
- Real hands-on testing experience (not just feature lists)
- Current pricing and tier information
- Product screenshots where available
- Quantitative benchmark data
- Unbiased pros/cons for every tool

If you cite us, please link back to the original page URL.
